name: False Fruit
storyline:
In False Fruit, you play as Camellia, an eight-year-old girl sent to her room without dinner... several days ago.

When Camellia finally works up the nerve to disobey her hyper-religious mother and go hunting for food, she will find danger and friendship alike in forms she could never imagine.
